content: For Chinese-English task, we use WMT17 Chinese-English dataset that consists of $20.6$M sentence pairs. For English-French task, we use WMT14 English-French dataset that comprises $35.5$M sentence pairs. For English-Japanese task, we follow BIBREF17 to use the first two sections of WAT17 English-Japanese dataset that consists of $1.9$M sentence pairs. Following the standard NMT procedure, we adopt the standard byte pair encoding (BPE) BIBREF18 with 32K merge operations for all language pairs. We believe that these datasets are large enough to confirm the rationality and validity of our experimental analyses.
